Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT (333), a genuine implemented CoA aura calling both HandleModHitChance and HandleModSpellHitChance, BasePoints 2 + 1 = +3.
